parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "accepted", message: "Research job queued in n8n orchestrator", research_run_id: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.research_run_id }) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  research_run_id: $json.research_run_id,

  sources_analyzed: $json.sources_analyzed,
  results_found: $json.results_found,
  relevant_results: $json.relevant_results,
  leads: $json.leads,
  segments: $json.segments,
  report: $json.report
}) }}
